stem_book: If sum of all the solutions of the equation log base ((9x − x² − 14)/7) of (sin3x − sin x) = log base ((9x − x² − 14)/7) of cos2x is equal to kπ/6, then find the value of k.
reason: stem rewritten with x² and explicit log base
work: base > 0 ⇒ x ∈ (2, 7) (base never 1); 2cos2x sin x = cos2x with cos2x > 0 ⇒ sin x = 1/2 ⇒ x = 5π/6, 13π/6 ⇒ sum 18π/6 ⇒ k = 18
